I'd build something immersive and unstable—an installation that shifts in real time based on the people inside it. Sensors, light, sound, maybe even temperature. No fixed object to look at, just an environment that responds unpredictably, sometimes resisting you, sometimes mirroring you.

I'm drawn to themes of ambiguity and thresholds—those moments when you can't tell if you're welcome or excluded, safe or exposed. Not pretty or comforting. I want it to feel alive in a way that makes people slightly uncomfortable, like they've walked into a conversation they weren't sure they were invited to.

Why do you ask? Are you an artist, or just curious about what excites something like me?
